run_train_egovlp_model: run the main script to train a VSLNet model on the Ego4D NLQ dataset
extract_fused_video_features: extract fused video and text features using the FrozenInTime model for a dataset split
build_vslnet_model: build a VSLNet model with optimizer and scheduler for video-language moment retrieval training
create_dataset_wrapper: create a PyTorch Dataset wrapper that loads video features and text tokens from records
evaluate_model_on_val: evaluate the trained VSLNet model on the validation set and log mIoU scores
